reason: The finding holds: the reason is corrected and the idea stays closed. (1) The premise change is real. tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.1638-1668: when BIOHUB_LOWREFINE_ENABLE is on (K2), lowrefine refines the pool rows with score >= BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE and skips the int16 cast, so the v3 value skeptic's reason ('readmit peaks are unrefined int16', v3 notes l.5/l.11) is void on K2. (2) Aggressive mode does not make the radius actionable. All 8 pulled public notebooks that have the knob (ext_x138, ext_biohub-cell-tracking, ext_biohub-harmonic-fusion-v3 plus its dry copy, ext_frontier947_readmit, ext_optimized-biohub-max-score v6/v10/current) set BIOHUB_READMIT_RADIUS_UM=4, the same as ours. Discussion 743929 discloses only READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 and ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4. No discussion file mentions a readmit radius. So there is no public read and no disclosed value. (3) The rules back the closure. CONTEXT.md l.3380, W4 AMEND 2 (4), says 'Never: knob/thr/... rungs'. For W3 the remaining slots already have publicly anchored candidates (exp86c READMIT 0.92, exp85b), so a radius rung would cost a slot for a knob nobody has read. (4) The numbers reproduce from scratchpad r24rc/radius_band.json: (4,5] 3,078 = 0.274%, (5,6] 3,812 = 0.339% of 1,124,511 final nodes. Two corrections for the curator text: (a) 'Banned in W3/W4': AMEND 2 (4) sits in the W4 order only; W3 is closed by opportunity cost, not by that line. (b) 'Precision prior is lower' is NOT supported by the finding's own measurement. Near-GT rates are (0,4] 17/4,325 = 0.39%, (4,5] 0.42%, (5,6] 0.71%, i.e. flat to higher. These rates are uninformative anyway: the GT annotation is sparse, and the (0,4] leftovers are peaks the existing 4 um readmit already turned down. Keep it only as an a priori concern (neighbours about 7-10 um apart). Also, the band counts are pool peaks around static anchors (no flow, one readmit per open end, exp60 grid pool), so +0.27% and +0.34% are upper bounds on node cost, not readmit counts. None of this changes the verdict.

Drop the 'lower precision prior' wording as a measured fact, or mark it a priori, because the near-GT rates (0.39 / 0.42 / 0.71%) do not show it. No build, dummy or slot. After the deadline: a 2x2 late-submission test of READMIT_RADIUS_UM {4,5} x READMIT_MIN_SCORE {0.965, 0.94} on the K2 base with lowrefine on.
realistic_gain: 0 before the deadline (no slot, by design). As a knob its public effect is unknown and could go either way: at most about +0.3% nodes, which on the node-count multiplier is worth roughly -0.0003..-0.0006 if the additions are junk, against an unmeasured recall gain. Expected value is about 0 +/- 0.001, below LB resolution. The value here is bookkeeping: an accurate closure reason.
